summary: The null-deref flow starts at System.getProperty("CWE690") in 71a (which returns null when the property is unset) and reaches the dereference data.equals("CWE690") in 71b's badSink. I add a null guard around the dereference so the sink only compares when data is non-null, preserving the legitimate behavior (printing when the property equals "CWE690") for valid inputs while avoiding the NullPointerException.
